result: acted: opened PR #745 — check-ci-liveness.mjs conflated 'could not look' with 'the sweep is dark'. Found by being hit: PR #742's gating job failed at 14:32:48Z claiming the mutation sweep was dark while scheduled-verification run 34853811860 had all FOUR shards green 14:14:33-14:20:54Z, inside the 48h threshold; the same commit passed on re-run unchanged, so the payload differed, not the repo. Three cases all returned null and all reported as the third: no runs returned, runs with no sweep job (renamed or empty payload), and every shard failing. Only the last is the finding. classifyScan now separates them, the could-not-look arm is fatal in CI with its own message and reported-not-fatal off CI, and the per-run diagnostic moved above the continue so a red verdict is no longer accompanied by an empty log. Four self-test cases falsified by planting the old conflation. Threshold, RUNS_TO_INSPECT and the shard rule untouched — a genuinely dark sweep fails exactly as before. preflight 320 green, breadth 56 green. Owner-gated SAFETY_MACHINERY, not self-merged. Backlog updated under Done (recent) with PR #745.
